# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**6:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have held me up with Your strength and poured out Your holy spirit on me.

**6:2** I will not stumble. And You have made me strong in the face of wickedness and its attacks.

**6:3** And even when they brought total destruction, You never let me be driven from Your covenant.

**6:4** You have made me a strong tower, a high wall, and You have built me on a foundation of solid rock.

**6:5** And set eternal footings beneath me, and all my defenses are a battle-tested wall that will never collapse.

**6:6** And You, my God, have appointed me as sacred guidance for the exhausted, and You have rooted me in Your covenant.

**6:7** And my tongue speaks as one trained by You. But the destructive spirit has no words to counter.

**6:8** And none of the guilty have a reply, for lying lips will be sealed shut.

**6:9** For everyone who attacks me in a dispute, You will judge against them, using me to draw the line between the righteous and the wicked.

**6:10** For You know the motivation behind every action and You can read every word the tongue speaks.

**6:11** And You have shaped my heart through Your teaching and Your truth, steering my steps onto righteous paths.

**6:12** So that I walk in Your presence in the land of the living, on paths of glory and endless peace.

**6:13** Without stopping, and it is understood [...] and nothing happens outside Your will.

**6:14** I have anchored myself in Your covenant-faithfulness and in Your overflowing mercy.

**6:15** For You forgive wrongdoing and cleanse people of guilt through Your own righteousness.

**6:16** Not for humanity's sake, but for the sake of Your own glory You have done it.

**6:17** For You created both the righteous and the wicked [...] from the womb You assigned their destinies.

**6:18** For the season of blessing and the witness of [...] You have set them apart since before time.

**6:19** Before You ever created them You already knew everything they would do, for ever and ever.

**6:20** And nothing happens without Your will, and nothing is known except what pleases You.

**6:21** You shaped every spirit and their [...] and the verdict on all their actions You have already determined.

**6:22** You unfurled the heavens for Your glory, and You positioned every star and angel by Your own choosing.

**6:23** And the mighty spirits each with their own rules, before they ever became Your holy angels.

**6:24** And the eternal spirits each in their own domain, the heavenly lights on their tracks, the stars following their routes.

**6:25** And every storm-wind with its assignment, the lightning and thunder each with their duty.

**6:26** And the deep reservoirs with their function, and the storehouses of [...] with their [...]

**6:27** You made the earth by Your power, the seas and all the deep waters.

**6:28** And [...] You brought into order by Your wisdom, and everything in them You placed according to Your purpose.

**6:29** And the human spirit that You fashioned in this world for all the ages that stretch to eternity.

**6:30** And the generations that never end to [...] each in their appointed era.

**6:31** And You parceled out their tasks across all their generations and judgment at just the right moments.

**6:32** Through all the eternal ages [...] and You decreed it for them through the wisdom of what You know.

**6:33** And before they even existed You knew their every deed, and nothing is done that falls outside Your will.

**6:34** And You are the source of all knowledge, and everything that is exists because it pleased You.

**6:35** And no one else can stand against Your plans, or uncover the full scope of Your sacred purpose.

**6:36** Or look into the abyss of Your mysteries, or wrap their mind around all Your wonders.

**6:37** Along with the sheer force of Your power — and who can survive Your glory?

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 6 is a theological powerhouse. The personal testimony of divine protection (6:1-13) transitions into one of the most deterministic passages in all ancient literature (6:14-37). God created both righteous and wicked. Nothing happens outside God's will. This is not fatalism but worship. The "holy spirit" language (6:1) is remarkable for a pre-Christian Jewish text.*
